strands.name: Numbers
strands.description: Operations on whole numbers, factors, fractions, decimals, and squares/square roots.

substrands.name: Whole Numbers
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to use place value and total value of digits up to hundreds of millions in real life
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to read and write numbers in symbols and in words up to hundreds of millions

substrands.name: Factors
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to test divisibility of numbers by 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10 and 11
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to apply GCD and LCM in real-life situations

substrands.name: Fractions
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to compare, add, subtract, multiply and divide fractions in different situations

substrands.name: Decimals
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to identify place value and total value of digits in decimals and perform combined operations

substrands.name: Squares and Square Roots
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to determine squares and square roots of whole numbers, fractions and decimals

strands.name: Algebra
strands.description: Forming and simplifying algebraic expressions, linear equations, and linear inequalities.

substrands.name: Algebraic Expressions
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to form and simplify algebraic expressions in real-life situations

substrands.name: Linear Equations
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to form and solve linear equations in one unknown in real-life situations

substrands.name: Linear Inequalities
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to form, solve and represent simple linear inequalities on a number line

strands.name: Measurements
strands.description: Pythagorean relationship, length, area, volume, capacity, time, speed, temperature, and money.

substrands.name: Pythagorean Relationship
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to recognize the sides of a right-angled triangle and apply the Pythagorean relationship to real-life situations

substrands.name: Length and Area
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to convert units of length and calculate perimeter and area of plane figures and combined shapes

substrands.name: Volume and Capacity
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to calculate volume of cubes, cuboids and cylinders and relate volume to capacity

substrands.name: Time, Distance and Speed
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to relate time, distance and speed and convert units of speed in real-life situations

strands.name: Geometry
strands.description: Angles, geometrical constructions, scale drawing, and common solids.

substrands.name: Angles
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to relate different types of angles on a straight line, at a point, and on a transversal

substrands.name: Geometrical Constructions
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to measure and bisect angles and construct special angles and triangles using a ruler and a pair of compasses

substrands.name: Scale Drawing
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to represent length to a given scale and convert scale from one form to another

strands.name: Data Handling and Probability
strands.description: Collecting, organizing, representing, and interpreting data in tables and graphs.

substrands.name: Data Collection and Organization
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to state the meaning of data, collect data from different sources, and prepare frequency distribution tables

substrands.name: Data Representation
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to draw pictographs, bar graphs, pie charts, and line graphs to represent data

substrands.name: Data Interpretation and Travel Graphs
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to interpret bar graphs, pie charts, line graphs, and travel graphs in real-life situations

strands.name: Practical Geography
strands.description: Foundations of geographic study, branches, career pathways, and topographical map analysis.

substrands.name: Introduction to Geography
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to analyse the branches of Geography for in-depth understanding of the subject
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to examine the importance of studying Geography for sustainable development
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to explore the relationship between Geography and other disciplines for identification of career pathways
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to select possible careers from branches of Geography in society
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to appreciate the significance of Geography in day-to-day life

substrands.name: Map Reading and Interpretation
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to illustrate the various methods of representing relief on topographical maps
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to interpret relief, drainage and vegetation on topographical maps for resource mapping
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to draw sketch sections from topographical maps for interpreting relief
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to appreciate the use of map reading and interpretation skills for national development

strands.name: Natural Systems and Processes
strands.description: Internal and external earth processes, classification of rocks, folding, vulcanicity, and earthquakes.

substrands.name: Rocks
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to examine the classification of rocks according to mode of formation and age
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to describe the distribution of rocks in Kenya
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to analyse the significance of rocks in Kenya
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to sample rock types in their locality
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to appreciate the economic and environmental significance of rocks in Kenya

substrands.name: Vulcanicity
learning_outcomes: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to explain the processes and features resulting from intrusive and extrusive vulcanicity in the Kenyan Rift Valley
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to assess the positive and negative effects of vulcanicity on human activities in Kenya
